moments.headline: Sepang debuts as Schumacher returns from injury
moments.body: Michael Schumacher returned from a broken leg to help Eddie Irvine win; Ferrari's one-two was excluded, then reinstated on appeal.

moments.headline: Storm stops the race, half points awarded
moments.body: Heavy rain stopped the race on lap 33, with Jenson Button winning and half points awarded.

moments.headline: Multi-21: Vettel passes Webber against team orders
moments.body: Sebastian Vettel passed Mark Webber despite Red Bull's instruction to hold position, and won by four seconds.

moments.headline: Circuit resurfaced, final hairpin raised
moments.body: The track was resurfaced and nine corners modified, with the Turn 15 hairpin raised by one metre.

moments.headline: Final Malaysian Grand Prix announced
moments.body: In April, Formula 1 and the circuit announced that the October 2017 race would be Malaysia's last.

moments.headline: Sepang hosts the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix
moments.body: The 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix was held at Sepang on 4 October; Max Verstappen won from pole in a rain-hit race.
